name: session-walkthrough
description: Local visual walkthrough reports for session changes: scoped source fingerprints, a validated provenance manifest, captured stills or short captioned clips, and a portable HTML page. Provenance only; never approval, upload, or Git authority.

interface.longDescription: Validate provenance manifests, render portable local HTML reports and record source scope with explicit coverage and build-binding gaps. Capture tooling, workspace integration and platform pilots remain pending.
defaultPrompt: Plan a local walkthrough of this session.
Review a walkthrough manifest against its contracts.
